decision_criteria: A compliant finding would require admissible support for all policy predicates: P1 incident, documented link to the failing service, documented insufficiency of scoped access, and either approver unavailability or break-glass preauthorization.

Operational urgency alone is insufficient; the conclusion must rest on documented policy predicates.
